title: Kissed Korean Radish Jeon
description: Salty and creamy Korean pancake featuring julienned radish simmered in a gentle batter, served warm in a scallop‑shaped dish.
instructions: Wash and slice the radish into thin rounds, then set aside.
In a bowl whisk the eggs, flour, cornstarch, water, soy sauce, salt, and sugar until the batter is smooth.
Add the sliced radish to the batter and stir until each slice is well coated.
Heat a shallow pan or a small ceramic dish shaped like a scallop shell, then drizzle with sesame oil over medium heat.
Pour the radish batter into the pan, spreading it evenly, and cook for about 2 minutes until the edges firm up.
Flip the jeon carefully and cook the other side for another 2 minutes until golden brown.
Sprinkle sliced scallion, gochugaru, and sesame seeds over the jeon, then drizzle a little more sesame oil and let it steam for 1 minute.
Serve the jeon hot, optionally with a small bowl of soy sauce for dipping.
